english: Man, you struck my bigger bull(?). I was first and you crossed me / got past me. Still you cross me. Look at my debt/guilt. Now let us divide the cattle(?) in two. Who will divide it? Let the knowing old man divide it. I will listen to him. And let us not fight.

Woman, your dog killed my lamb. My dog? At night it lay at the door. I saw him; his mouth was red. What do you want? Give me a lamb and let your dog stay at home. I will repay you a lamb and tie him up. Don't tie him; the dog knows nothing.

Friend, you took my horse to the feast. Where is it? Yesterday it died. Why didn't you tell me? You deceived me. I did not deceive you. I feared you. A friend has not harmed a friend. You speak truth. I will give you a young horse in spring. Swear to me. I swear, and Dyeus hears me.

Grandmother, my brother called me a stone (blockhead?). What did you do to him? I kicked his ... Now you (two) have done wrong(?). Call your brother here. He does not come; he is hurt. He spoke to him(?). Grandmother gives honey. Now he runs here. Eat honey and don't fight.

Who did not tend/grind the fire? Husband, you lie on (at rest). I toiled at work. I spun wool and cooked meat. And did you not tire? Now let us ... Bring wood and I will kindle the fire. I bring it; you (make) dough. Man, do not lie here and at the walls.

You pushed me and I fell. I did not push you; your foot slipped. My foot did not slip. Your guest crossed me. Now at the new moon let us race again, and let the women watch. Let them watch; I will win again. My feet are swift. Swift, and they slipped.
